wards.label: Ahmedabad municipal ward map
wards.detail: 48 digitised ward boundaries (441.1 km²) with measured area, perimeter, compactness and OSM road density.

parcels.label: OpenStreetMap land polygons
parcels.detail: 2,567 real mapped land boundaries with their real land-use tag. Surveyed blocks and estates, not cadastral title plots — GLIS records are not public.

tenure.label: Ownership — mostly modelled
tenure.detail: No public dataset records land tenure. OpenStreetMap confirms public ownership for only 10 of 2,567 parcels; the rest is modelled.

zoning.label: Official zoning — modelled
zoning.detail: Development-plan sheets are not published machine-readably, so the official designation is modelled. Zoning conflicts demonstrate the detection method; they are not confirmed violations.

facilities.label: OpenStreetMap
facilities.detail: 1,252 facilities via the Overpass API, de-duplicated and re-classified.

roads.label: OpenStreetMap
roads.detail: 2,480 major road segments via the Overpass API.
